		Flag = "SPHub_AntiFling",
		Callback = function(p120)
        if p120 then
            _G.AntiFling = true

            local self = setmetatable({}, {
					__index = function(p121, p122)
                local p122_2 = game:GetService(p122)

                if p122_2 then
                    p121[p122] = p122_2
                end

                return p122_2
            end
				})
            local LocalPlayer = self.Players.LocalPlayer

            local function v1240(p123)
                local u1733
                local HumanoidRootPart
                local function v1735(p124)
                    u1733 = p124

                    if not HumanoidRootPart then
                        local _ = _G.AntiFling
                    end

                    repeat
                        task.wait()
                        HumanoidRootPart = p124:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    until HumanoidRootPart or not _G.AntiFling
                end
                if p123.Character then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        v1735(p123.Character)
                    end)
                end
                p123.CharacterAdded:Connect(v1735)
                self.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not _G.AntiFling then
                        return
                    end

                    local v1821 = u1733

                    if v1821 then
                        v1821 = u1733:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
                    end

                    if v1821 then
                        v1821 = HumanoidRootPart

                        if v1821 then
                            v1821 = HumanoidRootPart:IsDescendantOf(u1733)
                        end
                    end

                    if v1821 and (HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 50 or HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 100) then
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(u1733:GetDescendants()) do
                            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                                descendant.CanCollide = false
                                descendant.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                descendant.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                descendant.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            for _, player in ipairs(self.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local v1243 = player

                if v1243 ~= LocalPlayer then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        v1240(v1243)
                    end)
                end
            end

            self.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(v1240)
            self.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not _G.AntiFling then
                    return
                end

                pcall(function()
                    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local v1825 = Character and Character.PrimaryPart or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if v1825 then
                        if v1825.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 250 or v1825.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 250 then
                            v1825.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            v1825.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

                            return
                        end

                        if v1825.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 50 or v1825.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude < 50 then
                            local _ = v1825.CFrame
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)

            return
        end

        _G.AntiFling = false
    end
	})

            getgenv().FreeCamScrollConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, _)
                if not getgenv().FreeCamNative then
                    return
                end

                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                    getgenv().FreeCamSpeed = math.clamp(getgenv().FreeCamSpeed + input.Position.Z * 2, 0.5, 100)
                    TextLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. tostring(getgenv().FreeCamSpeed)
                    n10 = tick()

                    if not u1281 then
                        u1281 = true
                        TweenService:Create(Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
								BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
							}):Play()
                        TweenService:Create(TextLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
								TextTransparency = 0
							}):Play()
                    end
                end
            end)
            getgenv().FreeCamFadeConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if u1281 and tick() - n10 > 3 then
                    TweenService:Create(Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {

						}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(TextLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
							TextTransparency = 1
						}):Play()
                end
            end)
        end

        getgenv().FreeCamConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not getgenv().FreeCamNative then
                return
            end

            if not v1272 then
                return
            end

            Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            local MoveDirection

            if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
                MoveDirection = v1272.MoveDirection
            else
                local v1739 = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) and 1

                if not v1739 then
                    v1739 = not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) and 0 or -1
                end

                local v1740 = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) and 1

                if not v1740 then
                    v1740 = not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) and 0 or -1
                end

                local v1741 = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) and 1

                if not v1741 then
                    v1741 = not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) and 0 or -1
                end

                MoveDirection = CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * v1739 + CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector * v1740 + CurrentCamera.CFrame.UpVector * v1741
            end

            if MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
                    Part.CFrame = Part.CFrame + MoveDirection * getgenv().FreeCamSpeed

                    return
                end

                Part.CFrame = Part.CFrame + MoveDirection.Unit * getgenv().FreeCamSpeed
            end
        end)

        return
    end

    if v1271 then
        v1271.Anchored = false
    end

        getgenv().FreeCamMouseConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    if getgenv().FreeCamScrollConnection then
        getgenv().FreeCamScrollConnection:Disconnect()

    end

        getgenv().SPHubModalGui:Destroy()
    end

    if getgenv().SPHubSpeedGui then
        getgenv().SPHubSpeedGui:Destroy()

    end

local v340 = (function()
    if identifyexecutor then
        local ok, result = pcall(identifyexecutor)

        if ok then
            ok = type(result) == "string" and #result > 0
        end

        if ok then
            return result
        end
    end

    if syn then
        return "Synapse X"
    end

    if KRNL_LOADED then
        return "Krnl"
    end

    if is_sirhurt_closure then
        return "SirHurt"
    end

    if pebc_execute then
        return "ProtoSmasher"
    end

    if secure_load then
        return "Sentinel"
    end

    return "Unknown"
end)()

        if ok and result then
            return tostring(result)
        end
    end

    return "unknown"
end)()
